steps.fact: Commercial notes state that legal has not determined which registry entity is the contracting party and instruct to treat the registry link as unresolved.
A 2024 credit check returned a Wyoming LLC named "Northbridge Analytics LLC", preserving multiple live registry candidates beyond registry:3840192.
Registry row 3840192 lists the entity name as "NORTHBRIDGE ANALYTICS INC" (Delaware, active).
Billing invoices bill the name "Northbridge Analytics Inc."
The candidate left referent is billing:Northbridge Analytics Inc. and the right referent is registry:3840192.
Name similarity between the billing name and the registry row name is insufficient under the relation contract to establish SAME_ENTITY identity.
No packet excerpt links billing:Northbridge Analytics Inc. to registry identifier 3840192 via a shared legal identifier or an explicit identity mapping.
No packet excerpt establishes that billing:Northbridge Analytics Inc. and registry:3840192 are distinct entities.

support_claim: The packet explicitly leaves the registry link unresolved, names an alternate Wyoming LLC candidate, and provides only name-level overlap without a legal-identifier or mapping that establishes identity or distinctness between billing:Northbridge Analytics Inc. and registry:3840192.
